values: 一名自私残暴的战士，会不顾队友的安危制造范围伤害。
A brutal Warrior who deals AoE damage without regard for teammates' safety.
让我来见证，你的死亡吧
Oh, look at you, darling. Hey, what are you looking at?!
你的力量，哈哈……不过如此
Your power... haha... is nothing compared to mine.
Hmph! So you were here all along!
Yes, this is worthy of me.
蝼蚁才会喜欢这种东西！
Only a sea slug would like this!
累累尸骨匍匐在他脚下，他带来如同潮水般蔓延的死亡。
Steeped in the echoes of those lost to the sea.
亡者在他的号令下再度站起，阴冷的气息将海水都凝成了冰。
A chilling presence, commanding the tides to freeze at your feet.
居然和一群蝼蚁蜗在这里……
Can't believe I'm stuck here with some weaklings...
Don't even think about spying on me.
哼，煮熟的吃起来有什么劲！
I'm not interested in cooked food!
Not even an iceberg can stop a ship!
Not bad, I'm getting excited too!
每当海上不知名的号角吹响，棱骨锐利的船头在雾气中若隐若现……这片海域的人都知道谁要来了。他们躲起来，悄声祈祷这片海域的劫掠者——霍德希金的眼光不要落在自己身上。

Whenever a loud horn sounds on the high seas, and a huge ship looms out of the fog, everyone knows who's coming. They hide and pray that the ravager of the deep, Hodgkin, would not set his undead eyes on them.
生而为蝼蚁并不可悲，可悲的是蝼蚁们无法克制互相戕害的本性。为了不成为被践踏的蝼蚁，霍德希金不惜代价追求一切增强力量的方式。

Being born as lowly as an insect isn't tragic. The real tragedy is that these lowly creatures cannot help but kill and destroy each other. In order to not get trampled on in this world, Hodgkin pursues all means of increasing his power.
将柔软的血肉手臂换成强悍凶猛的金属钩爪后，霍德希金初次体会到了“置换”的好处——置换带来力量，他无比笃信。
After replacing his soft human arm with an indestructible hook, Hodgkin experienced the benefits of this type of sacrifice for the first time. He now firmly believes sacrifice brings strength.
霍德希金用班题斯圣器制造的第一个亡灵就是波妮，尽管波妮战力不弱，但他并不满意。波妮的心不够冷硬，这是致命的弱点。

Bonnie was the first Graveborn that Hodgkin created with the Bantus Void Relic. Although her skills in battle are outstanding, he was not satisfied. He believed that Bonnie had a fatal flaw. Her heart was not ice cold to his liking.
霍德希金曾经豢养了一只猎鹰，那只鹰和他一样瞎了一只眼睛，也和他心意相通，总能在海上为他指明新的狩猎方向。但那只鹰老了后，他毫不犹豫地把它喂给了海怪。

Hodgkin once raised a falcon, which was blind in one eye like him. The bird cared for him and always found new prey for him out on the open seas. But when the falcon grew old, he did not hesitate to feed it to a kraken.
在霍德希金身边生存的哲学——你可以不忠诚，但一定要确保自己对他有用，否则就会像那只老鹰一个下场。
In order to survive around Hodgkin, you must learn to think like him. You can be disloyal, but you have to be useful to him. Otherwise, you will end up with the fate as his falcon.
如何败而不死，曾是霍德希金一直想解决的难题。直到他在一次劫掠中发现一位亡灵，刑讯逼供之下，对方告知班题斯帝国有名为班题斯圣器的宝贝，可以让他永远不会死去。

How to cheat death had always been a puzzle that Hodgkin yearned to solve. He found his answer when he found a Graveborn during a robbery. After hours of torture, Hodgkin learned of the Bantus Void Relic.
霍德希金很满意亡灵形态的自己。作为亡灵，不用进食，不会疲倦，不知疼痛，也永远不会死去。多棒啊，即使他被打败，他也总有卷土重来的机会。

Hodgkin is very happy with his undead form. As a Graveborn, he doesn't need to eat, doesn't feel pain, never gets tired, and, of course, he's immortal. Even if he is defeated, he always has another chance at his enemies.
海上的朝阳晒不干不死号上经年的血腥味，霍德希金尤其沉迷这种血腥味，称其为他强悍力量的证明。

The morning sun and the waves of the sea could never wave away the scent of blood that's accumulated on the Immortal. Hodgkin is particularly fond of this smell and proclaims that it's proof of his strength.
危险的海域里，弱者注定被强者吞噬。霍德希金从不怜悯，用他的话来说，生存之道，不够强是原罪。
In the dangerous waters of the open seas, the weak are destined to be devoured by the strong. That's the reason why Hodgkin never shows mercy. To be weak is a sin in itself.
这里的人没有恶意,您不必担心。
Please don't worry. The people here have no ill intentions.
你是难缠的对手，但你还不够格成为那万中无一。
You're a tough one, I'll grant you that—but don't flatter yourself. You're hardly exceptional.
维珀里安，我知道你在盘算什么，你要做的只有研究班题斯圣器，别有其他念头。
I know what you're thinking, but I want you to focus on studying the Void Relic. No distractions.
霍德希金 & 维珀里安
